Yes, the buyer is likely to prevail, because the shutters had become fixtures. They were custom-made and screwed and bracketed into the window frames, so they were annexed to the realty and adapted to its use. A warranty deed conveys fixtures along with the house unless they are expressly excluded, and the man's removal of them after the sale gave the buyer a claim for their return or value. Repairing and repainting the frames afterward doesn't change their fixture status.

CONFIDENCE: 80
